posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
Jasanimation said:
Im not sure what settings is for 'Skills wait'
Click to expand...
its not a setting. its a coded behavior within the plugin. if youre familiar with yanfly's action sequences, its the battle engine core that actually implements the core of it. more importantly, adds the default one which makes skills wait for the animations to end before doing damage popups. the action sequence plugins just add ways to interact with them.
Jasanimation said:
Also yes i tried turning off every other plugin thats not the YEP battle engine and the MOGhunter battle hud, the damage popup is still showing up during the animation
Click to expand...
how about just yanfly's battle engine? if it is playing the animations instantly with just that plugin alone, then you might want to try redownloading a new copy of it from the itch.io page.
